Virtual Desktop: Delivered at least one production AVD or Omnissa / VMware Horizon deployment, including non-persistent pools, image lifecycle, and FSLogix or DEM / App Volumes at scale. Azure Networking: Deep experience with VNets, UDRs, Azure Firewall (Premium TLS inspection preferred), Private Link, DNS, and NSGs, including troubleshooting broken TLS chains. IaC & Identity: Expert Terraform or Bicep run through CI/CD; Packer or Azure Image Builder; Entra ID, RBAC, PIM, managed identities, Key Vault, and Azure Policy. Working knowledge of Windows 11 multi-session hardening and Linux for container workloads; clear writer who can get a design approved by a Cyber Risk reviewer. Nice to Have / Preferred Qualifications: Certifications: Azure: AZ-104, AZ-700, AZ-140, AZ-305; Terraform Associate; VCP-DTM. Tuning CarbonBlack App Control, BeyondTrust EPM, CrowdStrike, or Defender for Endpoint for developer workloads. Business Acumen: Technology ultimately is used to enable the business. We look for people who understand how the businesses can be enabled through their technical solutions All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Strong experience in operations, support, and troubleshooting of large/complex networks end-to-end including hybrid cloud architectures. Active interim secret clearance with the ability to obtain a top secret clearance. Preferred Experience, Skills & Attributes Low Earth Orbit Satellite design including Starshield design and implementations. Firsthand experience in developing and providing quality assurance review of engineering change orders relating to the replacement or enhancement of perimeter security hardware and software. Experienced with performing root cause analysis, risk identification, and risk mitigation. Expert Knowledge of cabling standards, fiber optic and copper cable termination. Understanding of cutting-edge technologies such as SDN (Software-Defined Networking), IoT (Internet of Things), 5G, and cloud-native networking. Industry-recognized certifications such as CCIE (Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert), CCNP (Cisco Certified Network Professional), CCDP, JDCI, CCVP, AWS Certified Advanced Networking, Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, or similar cloud networking certifications. Familiarity with automation tools and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Ansible, Terraform, CloudFormation) to streamline network operations and reduce manual tasks in both on-premises and cloud environments. Expertise in network performance monitoring tools (e.g., NeuralStar, SolarWinds, Nagios, NetFlow, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor) and advanced troubleshooting techniques. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools for cloud network deployment and management. Knowledge of cloud security best practices, including network segmentation, encryption in transit, and cloud-native security services. Experience with multi-cloud and hybrid cloud architectures and connectivity solutions. Familiarity with DoS environment (data and voice networks, IT security systems, policies and procedures), Foreign Affairs Handbooks (FAHs), Foreign Affairs Manuals (FAMs). Interpersonal skills including the ability to collaborate effectively, self-awareness, and excellent presentation skills. Target salary range $120,001 - $160,000.
